text:
Maya: Quick heads up — want to lock down an SI co-sell clearinghouse window for next quarter. I propose a recurring ops sync + daily claim window to reduce overlap. Thoughts? @Ben @Ashley :wave:
Ben: +1 on a clearinghouse idea. Suggest daily claim window 8:30–10:30 PT so our EMEA SIs can hand off before EOD. Short 15m triage after window?
Ashley: prefer 9–11 PT instead, mornings are tight but less confusion. If we do staggered windows we need a single canonical account map and clear adjudication rules.
Maya: Staggered windows could work — US claim window 9–11 PT, EMEA claim window 16–18 CET. Main deliverables: canonical account CSV, adjudication SLA, and a one-page rules of engagement (RoE).
Ben: I'll draft a CSV template. Proposed headers:
```
account_id, account_name, region, primary_sales_owner, si_partner, claim_ts, claim_owner, evidence_link
```
Ashley: add a "claim_type" column (intro/demo/opportunity) and "ARR_bucket" so we can prioritize. Also: RoE bullets: no double-claims, show last-demo evidence, escalate overlaps within 24h.
partners-bot: created issue #452: "si-clearinghouse/ops" — link: https://redwood.internal/si-clearinghouse/452 (please add comments) :robot_face:
Devin: DevEx can run nightly dedupe and flag potential duplicates by domain and company id. We can post a summary to #partnerships/si-daily and attach CSV diff.
Ben: awesome. For adjudication SLA propose: 48h first-pass triage, 72h final decision unless customer engagement requires faster. Pilot should have human in loop for edge cases.
Maya: agree. Pilot plan: 2-week pilot, start Monday. Roles: Sarah owns triage, Ben owns CSV maintenance, Devin owns automation. I'll run ops sync and handle escalations.
Sarah: happy to own triage during pilot. I'll need access to the partner CRM folder + demo recordings.
Ashley: I'll prep the RoE doc (one-pager) and include examples of acceptable evidence and escalation steps.
Ben: small ask — can we include an automated badge in the CSV for "claimed_by_last_demo" (true/false) so triage knows priority.
Devin: will add dedupe rule to compute `claimed_by_last_demo` via meeting metadata. We can also surface a confidence score (0-100).
Maya: perfect. Calendar: ops sync Monday 10am PT (30m), daily claim window 9–11 PT (US) / 16–18 CET (EMEA). Pilot owners: Sarah (triage), Ben (mapping), Devin (automation), Maya (escalation).
Ben: sending draft CSV + sample rows in thread in a bit.
Ashley: and I'll drop the RoE draft by EOD Friday. :memo:  
Maya: thanks team — trying to reduce back-and-forth during launches. If anyone can't make Monday invite ping me and we'll move. :pray:
